text:
Anya K.: FYI the linkcheck job failed for staging after the content migration, looks like an image URL + fragment mismatch. CI output attached.

DocsBot: CI linkcheck failed on build #452 for branch docs/migrate-images - https://ci.redwood/452 (see step: linkcheck) :warning:

Anya K.: Error snippet: 
```
WARN  Broken fragment: /guides/embeddings.md#practical-tips -> fragment not found
WARN  Missing file: /assets/images/embedding-diagram.png -> 404
```

Samir: Are we sure the heading got a new slug? I think we renamed the heading from "Practical tips" to "Practical tips for embeddings" in the MDX conversion, which would change the auto-generated anchor.

Mike L.: quick debug: run `yarn workspace docs run linkcheck --path guides/embeddings.md` locally. If the heading changed we can either add an explicit id or update the link target.

Anya K.: I ran the local check. Confirmed new anchor is `#practical-tips-for-embeddings`. The incoming link is still pointing at `#practical-tips`. PR #789 updated the file path but not the fragment.

Olivia P.: Easy fix options: 1) Update the referring links (favored) 2) Add an explicit short id on the target heading using MDX: `### Practical tips for embeddings {#practical-tips}` 3) Add a redirect rule in the docusaurus config for fragment fallback (ugly). I can do a small PR to update the few references.

Samir: I prefer updating refs rather than adding ids unless we need a stable short anchor for external links. How many refs are broken?

Anya K.: Search found 3 references across guides and a few in SDK snippets: `grep -R "embeddings.md#practical-tips" -n docs/` -> results in 3 files.

Mike L.: If you update refs, please also update the example in the Python SDK snippet — it links to the section in the guide. I can patch that in the same PR so the SDK examples stay in sync.

DocsBot: Suggested checklist for PR: 
- [ ] Update broken link targets to `#practical-tips-for-embeddings`
- [ ] Update SDK snippet links in `examples/`
- [ ] Run `yarn build` and `yarn linkcheck` locally
- [ ] Add a short note in the migration changelog section

Anya K.: I'll open a PR with the three link updates + SDK snippet change and run the checks. Drafting now.

Anya K.: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 - includes link updates and a test to catch fragment mismatches. CI kicked off.

DocsBot: PR 812 - linkcheck job passed locally, CI queued.

Olivia P.: Thanks Anya. Once CI clears can we add a one-line entry in the migration guide so future cross-links don't regress? Small note under "MDX heading behavior".

Anya K.: Yep will add that before merging. :white_check_mark:

Samir: Optional: we should add a unit check in our pre-commit that runs a quick fragment validator for changed files only. Could save these headaches.

Mike L.: Agree, flagging for the infra backlog. For now PR 812 should unblock staging once it merges.

Anya K.: CI passed and merged. Staging linkcheck green. Closing thread. :tada:
